source: Lead required concurrency correction for multiple-task coordinator; current51 source-bound controls retained.

owner_concurrency.queue: no unbounded request queue; reject excess connection before work
owner_concurrency.serialization: same task only; no global lock over execution
owner_concurrency.public_forwarding: same fixed SCHEMAS, validation and owner-bound existing application handlers; no arbitrary method names

case.oracle: With first actual owned command at a controlled barrier, another scoped task and a read complete before release; an observed authored human hold is processed, revokes first execution and yields actual stop. Same-task callers create at most one worker.
